description: The astrology of a day (default today): the signs of the Sun and the Moon, the Moon phase named for that day and its lit fraction, the next new moon and full moon with their signs and whether either is an eclipse, and what the current phase means. For questions about today's astrology, the Moon today or the next full moon. It does not depend on a birth chart.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to cut the day (default UTC).

name: sky_today
title: Today's sky and Moon phase
